root_text.title: වාතමෘග ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa
root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 2. සීල වර්ගය

14. වාතමෘග ජාතකය

Msdiv 14“ආවාසයෙහිද මිත්‍ර සන්ථවයෙහිද ඇල්ම ලාමකය. ඒ දෙකට වඩා රසයෙහි ඇල්ම ලාමකවේ. ඊට වඩා අධිකවූ ඇල්මක් නොම ඇත්තේය. ඒ එසේමැයි. වන ලැහැබ ඇසුරුකළාවූ වාත මෘගයා සඤ්ජය නම් උද්‍යානපාල තෙම රසයන්ගෙන් තමා වසඟයට පැමිණවීයයි.”

වාතමිගජාතකං චතුත්ථං.

AP de Zoysa edition.

suttaplex.blurb: “There’s nothing worse.” This story was told by the Master while at Jetavana, about the Elder Tissa, called Direct-alms the Less. Tradition says that, while the Master was dwelling at the Bamboo-grove near Rajagaha, the scion of a wealthy house, Prince Tissa by name, coming one day to the Bamboo-grove and there hearing a discourse from the Master, wished to join the Brotherhood, but, being refused because his parents would not give their consent, obtained their consent by following Rattha-pala’s example and refusing food for seven days, and finally took the vows with the Master.
